import numpy as np import matplotlib as mpl import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
# Supplied scientific data; all plotted values follow from these arrays. n = np.arange(4) u0 = np.array([1, 1, 1, 1], dtype=float) u1 = np.array([1, 0, -1, 0], dtype=float) x = np.array([4, 2, 0, 2], dtype=float) c0 = c1 = 2.0
background = c0 * u0 oscillation = c1 * u1 products0 = background * u1 products1 = oscillation * u1
if not np.array_equal(background + oscillation, x): raise ValueError("The supplied components do not reconstruct x.") if np.dot(u0, u1) != 0 or np.dot(u1, u1) == 0: raise ValueError("The supplied basis does not support the stated extraction.")
blue = "#33658A" teal = "#2A9D8F" terracotta = "#C66B4E" ink = "#263238" slate = "#657786" light = "#DFE5E7"
mpl.rcParams.update({ "font.family": "DejaVu Sans", "font.size": 10, "mathtext.fontset": "dejavusans", "text.usetex": False, "text.color": ink, "axes.labelcolor": ink, "xtick.color": slate, "ytick.color": slate, "axes.facecolor": "white", "figure.facecolor": "white", "axes.spines.top": False, "axes.spines.right": False, "svg.fonttype": "none", })
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(9.8, 4.4), dpi=100)
fig.text( 0.055, 0.945, "Inner products isolate orthogonal components", fontsize=16, weight="bold", va="center" ) # Mathtext font commands require explicitly braced arguments. fig.text( 0.055, 0.875, r"$x=c_0u_0+c_1u_1=[4,\,2,\,0,\,2]^{\mathsf{T}}$" r" $u_0=[1,\,1,\,1,\,1]^{\mathsf{T}}$" r" $u_1=[1,\,0,\,-1,\,0]^{\mathsf{T}}$", fontsize=11 )
lefts = [0.075, 0.385] plot_width = 0.245 for left, title in zip( lefts, ["A1 Background cancellation", "A2 Oscillation reinforcement"] ): fig.text(left - 0.020, 0.795, title, fontsize=10.5, weight="bold")
def stem_panel(rect, values, colors, bottom=False, ylabel=False): ax = fig.add_axes(rect) ax.axhline(0, color=slate, linewidth=0.8, zorder=1) for ni, value, color in zip(n, values, colors): ax.vlines(ni, 0, value, color=color, linewidth=2.1, zorder=2) ax.plot( ni, value, "o", ms=5.1, color=color, markeredgecolor="white", markeredgewidth=0.6, zorder=3 ) ax.set_xlim(-0.35, 3.35) ax.set_ylim(-2.65, 2.8) ax.set_xticks(n) ax.set_yticks([-2, 0, 2]) ax.set_yticklabels(["−2", "0", "+2"]) ax.tick_params(axis="both", labelsize=8.5, length=2.5, pad=3) ax.spines["left"].set_color(light) ax.spines["left"].set_linewidth(0.7) ax.spines["bottom"].set_visible(False) if bottom: ax.set_xlabel("Sample index, n", fontsize=9, labelpad=3) if ylabel: ax.set_ylabel("Amplitude", fontsize=9, labelpad=6) return ax
# First row: the two supplied signal components. stem_panel([lefts[0], 0.520, plot_width, 0.205], background, [blue] * 4, ylabel=True) stem_panel([lefts[1], 0.520, plot_width, 0.205], oscillation, [teal] * 4)
fig.text(lefts[0] + plot_width / 2, 0.740, r"$c_0u_0=[2,\,2,\,2,\,2]^{\mathsf{T}}$", ha="center", fontsize=10) fig.text(lefts[1] + plot_width / 2, 0.740, r"$c_1u_1=[2,\,0,\,-2,\,0]^{\mathsf{T}}$", ha="center", fontsize=10)
# The same element-wise weighting is applied to both components. for left in lefts: fig.text( left + plot_width / 2, 0.475, r"$\downarrow\quad \odot\,u_1=[1,\,0,\,-1,\,0]^{\mathsf{T}}$", ha="center", fontsize=10, color=slate )
# Second row: weighted samples; height and color both encode sign. stem_panel([lefts[0], 0.220, plot_width, 0.205], products0, [blue, slate, terracotta, slate], bottom=True, ylabel=True) stem_panel([lefts[1], 0.220, plot_width, 0.205], products1, [teal, slate, teal, slate], bottom=True)
fig.text(lefts[0] + plot_width / 2, 0.106, r"Sum $=+2+0-2+0=0$", ha="center", fontsize=10) fig.text(lefts[0] + plot_width / 2, 0.061, "Exact cancellation", ha="center", fontsize=10, color=blue, weight="bold") fig.text(lefts[1] + plot_width / 2, 0.106, r"Sum $=+2+0+2+0=4=2c_1$", ha="center", fontsize=10) fig.text(lefts[1] + plot_width / 2, 0.061, "Reinforcement", ha="center", fontsize=10, color=teal, weight="bold")
# One subtle divider separates sample-wise multiplication from extraction. fig.add_artist(mpl.lines.Line2D( [0.667, 0.667], [0.090, 0.805], transform=fig.transFigure, color=light, linewidth=0.9 )) rx = 0.705 fig.text(rx, 0.795, "A3 Extract the coefficient", fontsize=10.5, weight="bold") fig.text(rx, 0.710, "Sum the weighted samples", fontsize=10, color=slate) fig.text(rx, 0.648, r"$\langle x,u_1\rangle=4(1)+2(0)$", fontsize=12) fig.text(rx + 0.079, 0.592, r"$+\,0(-1)+2(0)=4$", fontsize=12) fig.text(rx, 0.491, "Normalize by the basis energy", fontsize=10, color=slate) fig.text(rx, 0.425, r"$\langle u_1,u_1\rangle=1^2+(-1)^2=2$", fontsize=11) fig.text(rx, 0.305, r"$c_1=\frac{\langle x,u_1\rangle}{\langle u_1,u_1\rangle}" r"=\frac{4}{2}=\mathbf{2}$", fontsize=18, color=teal) fig.text(rx, 0.172, r"$\langle u_0,u_1\rangle=0$", fontsize=11, color=slate) fig.text(rx, 0.119, "Orthogonality rejects the background.", fontsize=9, color=slate) fig.text(rx, 0.061, "All amplitudes are dimensionless.", fontsize=8.5, color=slate)
